info.name: Ditto HTTP RPC API Keys Apps API

description.content: The Ditto HTTP RPC API provides a RESTful interface for interacting with Ditto's distributed data store. It enables you to query, insert, update and delete data across your Ditto network while maintaining strong consistency guarantees.
